findings.body: The latest non-bookkeeping commit’s `Functional check:` paragraph reports only module imports and 10 passing tests. It does not say what the worker observed when using `forge work` and `forge close` for either covered item, or show the likely failure’s next-step message. An earlier commit contains that walkthrough, but `review.functional_check` reads only the latest qualifying commit (`src/forge/review.py:279-290`), so the reviewer does not receive it. Put the observed command outcomes for items 3 and 4 in the final functional-check paragraph.
